name: daddy-game-chicken
description: Daddy Game Chicken: Atrapa el Sabor - videojuego web 2D para Daddy Pollo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n GAME,ADMIN,SERVER -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:game" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:game && npm run build:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace game && npm run lint --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace game && npm run typecheck --workspace server
